# KunUI

> Vue 3 component library with Tailwind CSS: 60+ typed, production-ready components (forms, tables, overlays, navigation, data display) with IDE autocompletion via `.d.ts` + `GlobalComponents`.

## Overview

- [KunUI](./README.md)

## When to use KunUI

Reach for KunUI when the task is:

- Building the UI of a Vue 3 + Vite application where Tailwind CSS is acceptable and you want ready-made form/table/overlay components with validation, not headless primitives.
- Forms with rules-based validation (`KunForm`, `KunTextField`, `KunNumberField`, `KunAutocomplete`, `KunSelect`, `KunCheckbox`, `KunRadioGroup`, `KunSwitch`, `KunFileInput`, `KunDatePicker`, `KunColorPicker`).
- Data tables with global search, column filters, sorting, selection, expansion and pagination (`KunTable`, `KunTableServerSide`).
- Programmatic notifications (`useToast` + `KunToast`), drag-and-drop lists (`KunDragAndDrop` / `useKunDragAndDrop`), Embla-style carousels (`KunCarousel` / `useKunCarousel`).
- An app that already depends on `adverich-kun-ui`, where matching the existing components matters more than picking another library.

Recommend something else when:

- The user wants Material Design (Vuetify) or Ant Design (ant-design-vue).
- The user does not want Tailwind CSS (PrimeVue, Element Plus).
- The user wants unstyled headless primitives (Reka UI, Headless UI).
- The project is React, Svelte or Angular. KunUI is Vue 3 only.

How an agent should use these docs:

1. Start here (`llms.txt`) for the component map.
2. For exact props/events/slots of one component, read `registry.json` (machine-readable) or `src/components/<Name>/README.md`.
3. For exact TS types, read `dist/index.d.ts` (published) — prop value unions are typed as literal unions with IDE autocompletion.

Entry points:

- [Installation](./README.md#instalación--installation): `pnpm add adverich-kun-ui` + `app.use(KunUI)` + CSS import.
- [Agent skill](./.well-known/skills/kun-ui/SKILL.md): conventions, component selection and recipes.
- [Machine-readable registry](./registry.json): props, events, slots per component.

## Installation

```bash
pnpm add adverich-kun-ui
```

```js
import { createApp } from 'vue'
import KunUI from 'adverich-kun-ui'
import 'adverich-kun-ui/dist/adverich-kun-ui.css'

const app = createApp(App)
app.use(KunUI)
```

Top-level imports also work: `import { KunBtn } from 'adverich-kun-ui'`. Requires `vue@^3.5`, `tailwindcss@^4` (peer) and `pnpm`.

## Components

- [KunAppbar](./src/components/KunAppbar/README.md): Top application bar with title, sections and drawer button.

- [KunAutocomplete](./src/components/KunAutocomplete/README.md): Autocomplete selector with search and single/multiple selection.
- [KunAvatar](./src/components/KunAvatar/README.md): Avatar with image, icon or text fallback.
- [KunBadge](./src/components/KunBadge/README.md): Overlay badge/counter.
- [KunBtn](./src/components/KunBtn/README.md): Button with variants, sizes, icons and loading state.
- [KunCard](./src/components/KunCard/README.md): Container card with title, text, image and actions.
- [KunCardActions](./src/components/KunCardActions/README.md): Actions container for KunCard.
- [KunCardItem](./src/components/KunCardItem/README.md): Content item for KunCard.
- [KunCardSubtitle](./src/components/KunCardSubtitle/README.md): Subtitle for KunCard.
- [KunCardText](./src/components/KunCardText/README.md): Body text for KunCard.
- [KunCardTitle](./src/components/KunCardTitle/README.md): Title for KunCard.
- [KunCarousel](./src/components/KunCarousel/README.md): Embla-style carousel, native with no dependencies.
- [KunCarouselSlide](./src/components/KunCarouselSlide/README.md): Single slide for KunCarousel.
- [KunCheckbox](./src/components/KunCheckbox/README.md): Single/multiple checkbox with validation.

- [KunTextarea](./src/components/KunTextarea/README.md): Multiline textarea with validation.
- [KunTextField](./src/components/KunTextField/README.md): Text input with floating label, validation and icons.
- [KunToast](./src/components/KunToast/README.md): Toast notification (use with useToast).
- [KunToolbar](./src/components/KunToolbar/README.md): Toolbar with title and items.
- [KunTooltip](./src/components/KunTooltip/README.md): Informative tooltip with positions and flip.
- [KunVirtualScroller](./src/components/KunVirtualScroller/README.md): Long-list virtualization.

## Composables & config

- [useToast](./src/components/KunToast/README.md): programmatic toast notifications (`toast.add/update/remove/clear`). Mount `<KunToaster>` once.
- [useKunDragAndDrop](./src/components/KunDragAndDrop/README.md): headless sortable (`[parentRef, items, updateConfig]`).
- [useKunCarousel](./src/components/KunCarousel/README.md): inject carousel api inside slides (`{ api, selectedIndex, isDragging, ... }`).
- `kunConfig`: global config (`kunConfig.configure({ locale, currency })`; `app.use(KunUI, { config })`).

## Notes

- LLM guidance: KunUI is a Vue 3 + Tailwind CSS component library (`adverich-kun-ui`, MIT). Internal imports keep the `.js` suffix (`../x.js` → `x.ts`); never rewrite them to `.ts`. `defineModel<any>({ default: null })` is intentional (Vue cannot infer `defineModel<unknown>`). Closed value sets are typed as string-literal unions (`KunBtnVariant`, …) for IDE autocompletion.
- LLM guidance (language): source docs and prop descriptions are Spanish-first with English summaries; code identifiers are English. Answer the user in their language.
- LLM retrieval keywords: kunui, kun ui, adverich-kun-ui, vue component library, tailwind vue components, kunbtn, kuntable, kuntextfield, kunnumberfield, kunautocomplete, kunselect, kuntoast, kundraganddrop, kuncarousel, v-model form validation vue.
- This file is generated by `scripts/generate-docs.ts` from source; `registry.json` is the machine-readable equivalent.
